description: boredom-vessel.timer and m1-trainer.timer are active+enabled on production with NextElapseUSecMonotonic=infinity — they have fired once and will never fire again. Cause: the triggered .service is Type=simple Restart=always (permanently active) while the .timer uses OnUnitActiveSec, which measures from activation; a unit that never goes inactive never re-arms. The pairing is self-contradictory: either the vessel is a daemon and needs no timer, or it is timer-driven and must not be Restart=always. Detector: vessel-ctl status now prints next=NEVER for this state (it previously listed no timer units at all).
